parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in the specified document. Join docs filtered by document ChEMBL ID to compound_records, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter to keep only rows where canonical SMILES is present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
